items.after:
Reorder the 31 lessons in README.md's "lessons" section by increasing
mathematical/statistical difficulty, keeping Introduction first and Conclusion
last. New slug order (least to most sophisticated):

1.  schelling      — neighbour fractions, no continuous math
2.  vocab          — ratios and moving averages
3.  pollute        — fractions, mass conservation
4.  porous         — probability p, Monte Carlo fraction
5.  archcluster    — cell counting, connected components, centroids
6.  leastcost      — Dijkstra, edge-cost averaging
7.  align          — dynamic programming, integer arithmetic
8.  authorship     — n-gram counts, cosine similarity
9.  stemma         — Hamming distance, UPGMA arithmetic means
10. phylo          — UPGMA, four-point condition, bipartitions
11. vitals         — z-score (mean/std)
12. massspec       — Gaussian noise, sigma/sqrt(w), threshold
13. cellseg        — 2D Gaussian, convolution
14. wealth         — Gini coefficient, Lorenz curve
15. topics         — TF vectors, L2 norm, k-means, inertia
16. sdt            — hit/false-alarm rates, ROC, AUC
17. interp         — inverse-distance weighting, cross-validation
18. agreement      — Cohen's kappa, standard error
19. wordshift      — OLS slope
20. diffusion      — PDE finite differences, Taylor series, truncation error
21. heatwall       — steady-state heat equation, Jacobi iteration
22. lotka          — ODE system, equilibrium, linearization
23. sir            — ODE system, least-squares fitting, R0
24. mineral        — logistic regression, gradient descent, cross-entropy
25. tumor          — logistic regression, confusion matrix
26. learning       — nonlinear least squares, covariance, CI
27. radvel         — sinusoid fit, covariance, Cramer-Rao, significance
28. elasticity     — log-log OLS, standard error, t CI
29. flood          — log-normal, method of moments, return periods
30. survival       — maximum-likelihood estimation, censoring
31. breakpoint     — CUSUM statistic, detrending, critical values
